title: Systems Programming
description: Low-level programming challenges: memory management, concurrency, file I/O, process management

problems.title: Implement a Thread Pool
problems.description: Create a thread pool that manages a fixed number of worker threads and executes submitted tasks. Support graceful shutdown and task queuing.
requirements: Fixed number of worker threads specified at creation
submit(task) method to queue callable tasks
shutdown() waits for all tasks to complete

test_cases.input: pool = ThreadPool(4); results = [pool.submit(lambda: i*2) for i in range(10)]; pool.shutdown()

test_cases.expected: Running tasks complete, pending tasks cancelled

evaluation_criteria.correctness: Tasks execute correctly with proper results
evaluation_criteria.thread_safety: No race conditions under concurrent access
evaluation_criteria.resource_cleanup: All threads properly terminated on shutdown

problems.title: Memory-Mapped File Reader
problems.description: Implement a memory-mapped file reader that efficiently processes large files without loading them entirely into memory.
requirements: Implement line iterator for text files
Handle files larger than available RAM
Proper resource cleanup with context manager

test_cases.expected: First 100 lines returned without loading full file

evaluation_criteria.memory_efficiency: Memory usage stays constant regardless of file size
evaluation_criteria.correctness: Correct data returned for all access patterns

problems.title: Process Supervisor
problems.description: Create a process supervisor that manages child processes, handles crashes with automatic restart, and provides health monitoring.
requirements: Start and monitor multiple child processes
Automatic restart on crash with configurable backoff
Health check via heartbeat or HTTP endpoint

test_cases.expected: Worker starts and restarts on crash
All processes receive SIGTERM, force kill after timeout

problems.title: Lock-Free Queue
problems.description: Implement a lock-free concurrent queue using atomic operations (CAS). Must be safe for multiple producers and consumers.

test_cases.input: q = LockFreeQueue(); [Thread(target=q.enqueue, args=(i,)) for i in range(1000)]
test_cases.expected: All 1000 items enqueued without data loss
No race conditions, all operations complete

evaluation_criteria.performance: Better throughput than mutex-based queue under contention
